summary: Completed backend API regression and mobile-first UI workflow testing for KasFlow.
action_items: Consider adding error handling/toast around the delete API call so network failures do not produce an unhandled promise rejection.
Replace the inactive header menu button or remove it from the MVP UI.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js remove() awaits axios.delete without try/catch; failed deletion can leave the UI state ambiguous and emit an unhandled rejection.
The header menu button has no onClick behavior, so it is interactive-looking but does nothing.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST_api transaction and one UI regression transaction; uploaded temporary PNG evidence files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://expense-pulse-214.preview.emergentagent.com. Dashboard initially contained two seeded transactions. Mobile viewport 390x844 had no horizontal overflow. Core create, evidence upload, filters, delete, and Excel download all passed.
rca of the issue: No API or UI workflow failures reproduced. Remaining items are preventive code-review findings: remove() has no catch/finally path, and header-menu-button is rendered without behavior.
